prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years designing and deploying full-stack SaaS platforms and automation pipelines. Built cloud-native CRM and data‑ingestion modules that streamline client onboarding and accelerate service delivery. Developed automated validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional errors. Designed serverless backends that removed the need for dedicated servers. Applies disciplined operational rigor from military logistics to manage configuration tasks.

bullets.text: Built and deployed an operations CRM module on Cloudflare Workers using React and TypeScript, delivering a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines that accelerated VIP workflow service delivery by over 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to streamline onboarding of high-value enterprise clients.
Designed a six-stage agent pipeline with automated verification to enforce accurate pricing and claim data.
Engineered a web app on edge infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers, Vite, React, and TypeScript, adding automated audit and pricing models via Firecrawl and OpenAI.
Designed serverless backends that accessed Google Sheets through OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers.
Led migration from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, cutting manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed automated data-validation pipelines at the database layer, eliminating 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Managed $100M+ federal inventory across 12 sites for 8,000+ personnel, maintaining 100% audit accuracy and reducing processing time by 35%.
Enforced accountability procedures that removed supply chain bottlenecks during high-demand deployments, earning an Army Achievement Medal.
